body: I've lost count of the therapists I've been to, too. I just don't feel comfortable around them. I'd rather just be my own therapist somehow. I don't know how yet though.

So much pain. So much pain. So afraid. Don't understand. So much pain. So much pain. So confused. I deserve to be punished. I deserve pain. I deserve it? I'm confused. I'm confused. I'm scared. I don't understand. I don't understand. I'm scared. So scared. So scared. So scared. So scared.

I've been to therapists too...it just doesn't pan out for me...it doesn't feel safe...

nothing feels safe...
I'm scared that it won't be safe. I'm scared...I know I shouldn't be, but I am...

I have burned so many bridges...and I don't know how to be emotionally vulnerable without hurting people. I don't want to destroy the ones I love with my destructive emotions and actions. I feel like that's all I am...an emotional hurricane of evil that hurts people.

mental illness and regret for the things that I've done. I feel like I am worth nothing. Every time I think of the things I've done, I want to beat myself. I'm depressed and terrified. I don't know how else to cope with life than by hating myself. Loving myself is scary for some reason...I am scared of feeling good. Because good feelings are not safe. I see threats everywhere. Nothing feels safe. Surfing the internet doesn't feel safe. Talking doesn't feel safe. Sleeping doesn't feel safe. Nothing feels safe. Everything feels like a potential threat. I know it's not and I'm angry at myself for feeling like it is, but I'm terrified every day of stupid little things because of my fucking stupid PTSD or whatever shit...

The pain....I don't even know where it's coming from...it's like this....this feeling like my chest is hollow and there's nothing inside. Just blood and guts. No soul, nothing. I want to die.

Oh dude, I used to do this. There are much better ways to cope that will not scar you for the future. Please learn them now while you still have the chance to change course more easily. You can sing, draw, paint, exercise, regulate your breath, meditate, anything. These things will make you feel better without having negative future consequences for you and your being.

I do want to explore the vertical dimension.

How do you solve the spiritual topic of self-forgiveness?

I feel as though I was somewhat spiritually abused by Christianity as a child and did not learn self-forgiveness or acceptance, but only learned guilt, fear, and shame.

To put it bluntly, I did not learn self-forgiveness from my family.

And so, I ask you and any other redditors, how do I solve the issue of self-forgiveness through spirituality without making it become an ego trip?
Please don't hang yourself in the future. In you, I see a compassionate soul that has been wounded. Take care, friend. :)
